explanations: After billing a batch in parallel, pollOnce always commits the offset after the last record, even when some charges were rejected. Committing means "everything before this offset is done", so a failed click is skipped for good: the next poll starts after it and nothing ever redelivers it. At-least-once delivery requires committing only up to the first record that wasn't processed. The fix commits batch[firstFailure].offset when something failed, so the next poll re-reads from the failed click. Clicks after it that already succeeded are delivered again, which is safe because the ledger upserts by clickId.
